title: Adapter registry, format 3
description: One curated adapter (LoRA) registry format for image and video packages. Spec: FORMAT.md. Each entry is a superset of MLXToolKit's AdapterDescriptor (contract 1.53.0) and decodes as one. This schema is the authoring contract and is strict; readers must ignore unknown keys so later 3.x additions stay readable.

namespace.description: Registry namespace. An adapter's qualified id is '<namespace>:<id>'; catalogs that merge registries key on it.

baseModelKey.description: '<family>-<version>', e.g. ltx-2.3, ltx-2.5, flux2-klein-4b. Matched against AdapterSupport.baseModel.

id.description: Unique within the registry. Also names the adapter's cache file.

kind.description: AdapterKind. plain: weight delta only. ic: reference-conditioned; has conditioning slots.

format.description: AdapterFormat: the safetensors key dialect a package's AdapterSupport.formats matches. Engine constants: diffusers-peft, kohya, bfl-fused.

license.description: SPDXLicense identifier: SPDX id, LicenseRef-* for non-SPDX licences, NOASSERTION when the author states none.

strengthRange.description: The range this adapter was validated over. Omit when unknown: the surface's AdapterSupport.strengthRange applies.

conditioning.description: Ordered conditioning slots; kind 'ic' only. Array order is the binding order.

footprint.description: AdapterFootprint, measured with the package that applies it. Omitted for a plain adapter (the engine charges source.bytes). The engine refuses to register an ic adapter without one.

clearance.description: Per base model in baseModels: how far the fit was established there.

trigger.description: Text the prompt must carry for the adapter to fire. Omit when there is none.

promptTemplate.description: Canonical prompt. With no placeholder it is the default prompt when a request has none. Placeholders: {prompt}, {references}.

promptConvention.description: Id of a prompting convention an enhancer profile can apply.

baseInputs.description: The base model's own request inputs the adapter is built for (e.g. the i2v init image). Not adapter conditioning.

audioBranch.description: Joint audio-video adapters: carries audio-branch targets.

verification.description: Gate, perceptual and footprint evidence. Open: families record what their gates measure. Consumers must not branch on it.

level.description: perceptual: output judged on this base. mechanical: weight gate only (targets resolve, output moves, detach exact); safe to offer, effect not judged. declared: upstream says so, not measured by us.

variant.description: Checkpoint variant it was established on, e.g. distilled.

maxCount.description: How many inputs the role takes (an image set). Default 1.

defaultStrength.description: Reference conditioning strength when the request gives none.

describable.description: The slot takes a caller-written description that feeds {references}.

required.description: Whether the request must satisfy one alternative.

input.description: initImage: the base model's i2v first frame (T2VRequest.initImage).

commercialUse.description: conditional: allowed under terms the notice states (e.g. a revenue cap). unknown: no licence asserted; a commercial-use policy must refuse it.

gated.description: The operator must accept the terms before the adapter is enabled. Not the same as source.gated.

notice.description: Attribution or terms a host shows and carries in provenance.

revision.description: Full commit sha. Branch names are not pins.

gated.description: The hub repo is gated: downloading needs a token from an account that accepted its terms.

hashFrom.description: hub: sha256 is the hub's LFS oid at revision. local: hash of our verified copy whose size matches the hub at revision; the hub masks the oid without a token. Only gated sources may say local.

upstream.description: Where the bytes originate when repo is a mirror.

runtime.description: Family-specific parameters the package reads. Each key belongs to one family; adding one is a 3.x minor change.

referenceDownscale.description: ltx: spatial position scale for reference tokens (safetensors reference_downscale_factor).

audioReference.description: ltx: the IC adapter also appends a reference audio stream (LipDub).
